notes.title: Meet The Wild Case
notes.notes:
Please welcome our new adventure game The Wild Case. 

This is a 2D first-person point-and-click adventure. This is a story-focused adventure where players will meet a cast of colorful characters, experience mysterious encounters, and solve puzzles to progress through the game.

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't yet:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178230/The_Wild_Case
